title: Serve the European VRAM loader CPUSet banks
changes: Publish two typed halfword ranges and 11 caller literals in e320-d319. Use one physical source for overlapping and repeated copies, and preserve the encoded UI bank as the owner of the final 128 bytes.
validation: Wine unit 2t9frxi_ passed and drained. Five original CPUSet calls with altered backing match 74,972 VRAM bytes and the full saved state. Creation, reuse, verification, e319-d318 attachment, missing-bank rejection, the existing UI tail and raw gap fallback pass.

Build 64wom3c6 stopped after disk I/O errors and an aborted ext4 journal. Read-only recovery verified the preceding manifest, source plan, Wine overlay and six MinGW packages. The internal build 0o7fr_dm passed. Wine unit fxl7z0vm stopped before execution at the wrapper path check. The passing unit reused the same executable with the verified wrapper in the isolated checkout.
limitations: Ordinary entry and startup language, translated dispatch, original BIOS, native Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements. Primary Terra/xhigh settings unconfirmed.
